title: Ship AI Personallity - NOTE: only applies if EDCoPilot is dominant. See COVAS:NEXT Integration section below
CoPilot Name(s)
desc: *NEW* Optionally give your CoPilot a name, or alternates delimted by a comma, that it will occasionally use when addressing you or other NPCs

title: CoPilot Gender
desc: Your CoPilot's gender (male, female, non-specific)

title: Commander Address
desc: How you want CoPilot to refer to you

title: Commander Gender
desc: Your Commander's gender (male, female, non-specific)

title: Commander Nickname(s)
desc: How CoPilot will sometimes address you. Can be multiple nicknames separated by a , - example = Skipper,Boss,Mon Capitan

title: Fighter Crew Nickname(s)
desc: How CoPilot will sometimes address the fighter crew. Can be multiple nicknames separated by a , - example = Ace,Smeghead

title: Profanity Mode
desc: Whether you want clean announcements or some rather rude words indeed

title: Profanity usage probability
desc: Reduce this if you think your ship AI swears a little too often for your liking. This is a percentage probability it will include profane phrases in its random selection. 0=never, 100=always

title: Innuendo
desc: Whether you want phrases with sexual innuendo. This will also apply to all Space Chatter

title: Tough Love
desc: If ON will throw you the occasional insult or criticism in its responses

title: Sweetheart Mode
desc: Whether you want EDCoPilot to occasionally be nicer to you

title: Dislikes Mining
desc: If ON, will grumble about mining

title: Dislikes Trading
desc: If ON, will grumble about trading

title: Attitude to committing crimes
desc: How will the AI react if you commit a crime?

title: Alcohol Free
desc: If ON, will not make alcohol related comments

title: Vegan
desc: If ON, will not make meat consumption related comments

title: Stance on Xenos
desc: Is your AI anti-xeno, peace xeno (leave them alone), pro-xeno (anti-humanity)?

title: Convert spoken numerics to game language words
desc: If you are using a voice from a language not matching your game language, spoken numerics will be in the native voice language. If you set this ON, your ship AI will say the numbers in your game language

title: Chit Chat
desc: If ON, will say random phrases if hasnt spoken for x minutes, where you can set x on next option below

title: Chit Chat - minimum duration from last spoken line (in minutes)
desc: Set the number of minutes of no spoken EDCoPilot lines that will trigger a Chit Chat phrase

title: All Business Mode
desc: If on, will keep things professional, off = adds banter and humour.

title: COVAS:NEXT Integration - requires you to have installed and configured COVAS:NEXT
EDCoPilot Dominant
desc: If ON, EDCoPilot Ship AI will work as per normal and take charge. If OFF, EDCoPilot Ship AI will stop speaking / printing, and COVAS:NEXT will take over as the Ship AI. You may still give EDCoPilot voice commands via Voice Attack, and utilise the UI, but the EDCoPilot Ship AI will not make announcements based on these events.
